description: Embedded in every experiment record as 'dataset_provenance' (see experiments/schema.json) and served via GET /api/provenance/{id}. Keys mirror data/registry/datasets.json so the chain dataset -> version -> source -> publication -> transformation -> simulation -> result is always traceable. Documented in docs/data-provenance.md.

source.description: Origin of the data (lab/archive, or 'user upload' for unverified imports)

completeness.description: Scope of the dataset version used

limitations.description: Known gaps; always shown alongside results

model_version.description: Computational model name + version used in the run
